Yes. Sleeves are a comfort and warmth aid, not a requirement, so a torn pair is no reason to skip squats. Warm up with a few lighter sets first, since sleeves can make the early sets feel more settled than they are. If your working weight feels different bare, drop it a little for the first session and build back up.

If you want a replacement, any basic neoprene sleeve will do the same job. Want me to pull up your squat numbers so we can pick a sensible starting weight for today?
